name: Aquila
summary: A Jew born in Pontus who, with his wife Priscilla, worked alongside Paul as a tentmaker in Corinth. Together they explained God's way more fully to Apollos, and a church met in their home.

key_moments.title: Works with Paul as a Tentmaker
key_moments.description: Aquila and his wife Priscilla had come from Italy after Claudius ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul met them in Corinth and stayed and worked with them, because they were tentmakers like him.

key_moments.title: Sailing with Paul
key_moments.description: Paul stayed on a good while, then sailed toward Syria with Priscilla and Aquila. When they reached Ephesus, he left them there.

key_moments.title: Teaching Apollos
key_moments.description: Apollos preached with boldness at the synagogue in Ephesus, but he knew only John's baptism. Aquila and Priscilla took him aside and explained God's way to him more perfectly.

key_moments.title: Risking Their Lives for Paul
key_moments.description: Paul called Priscilla and Aquila his helpers in Christ, who had risked their own necks to save his life. He thanked them, as did all the Gentile churches, and greeted the church that met in their house.
